next.reason: The 1985 rule names the whole successful-completion class: 'Successful Completion. The input-output statement was successfully executed' (§1985:VIII.1.3.4 GR1). §2023:9.1.13.2 keeps that class, and each remaining 0x status states the statement is successfully executed (00, §2023:9.1.13.2 GR1 'is successfully executed and no further information is available'); 00 is one member, not a narrowing. Status 06 (§2023:9.1.13.2 GR5, 'A READ statement for a line sequential file has successfully executed but a line delimiter or the end-of-file has not been detected') and status 09 (§2023:9.1.13.2 GR7, 'the record contains one or more characters that are not in the implementor-defined character set for a line sequential file') are no longer targets: they are values of a line sequential file, an organization 1985 lacks, and state nothing this 1985 rule states (band-85/slice-10).
